workflow: Lock the intended use, prespecified clinical or biological endpoint and analysis population
Validate source identity, permissions, schema, units, lineage and missingness
Execute leakage-controlled multi-omics biomarker development with pinned code, models, references and deterministic parameters
Run leakage, calibration, subgroup, robustness and sensitivity analyses
Validate on an independent temporal, site, instrument, process or prospective evidence set
Complete expert review, signed release decision, rollback rehearsal and monitoring activation
quality_gates: Intended use, endpoint and acceptance criteria approved before analysis
Input permissions, provenance, schema, units and checksums verified
Code, environment, engine, reference and model versions pinned
Nested or repeated cross-validation is fully in-fold
Feature selection and imputation are leakage-safe
Clinical utility and decision-curve analysis are reported
Independent evidence, expert sign-off and formal release review complete
acceptance_criteria: No critical data-integrity or provenance failure
Prespecified primary performance and uncertainty criteria passed
Calibration, subgroup and robustness thresholds passed
Independent evidence meets the locked acceptance plan
Rollback and post-release monitoring are tested and approved
boundary: Multi-Omics Biomarker Discovery outputs remain research or operational decision support until the module-specific independent evidence, domain-expert review, applicable privacy/safety/clinical controls and formal controlled-release approval are complete.
